abilities.name: early-bird
abilities.effect: Makes sleep pass twice as quickly.

abilities.name: scrappy
abilities.effect: Lets the Pokémon's normal and fighting moves hit ghost Pokémon.

kanto.flavorText: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother’s protective pouch until it is three years old.

original-johto.flavorText: To avoid crushing the baby it carries in its pouch, it always sleeps standing up.

hoenn.flavorText: If you come across a young KANGASKHAN playing by itself, never try to catch it. The baby’s parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.

updated-johto.flavorText: To protect its young, it will never give up during battle, no matter how badly wounded it is.

original-unova.flavorText: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.

updated-unova.flavorText: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.

kalos.flavorText: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: If you come across a young Kangaskhan playing by itself, you must never disturb it or attempt to catch it. The baby Pokémon’s parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged at you.

original-alola.flavorText: The child in its pouch leaves home after roughly three years. That is the only time the mother is heard to cry wildly.

updated-alola.flavorText: You shouldn’t get close to the child when it’s playing outside its mother’s pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Raises its young in its belly pouch. Won’t run from any fight to keep its young protected.

swsh.flavorText: There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.
